audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 is right: Katarina's only ranged tool is Bouncing Blade at 625, Cassiopeia pokes at 850, and Miasma grounds Shunpo, the one ability that gets her in. The difficulty prose was fine; the pronouns were not.
audit.corrected: Kept the rating, fixed every 'he/his' — Katarina is she/her.

audit.why: phases[0..6].side and win[0..6] both read Cassiopeia on all seven rows and match the packet levelChart. No disagreement to fix.
audit.corrected: No chart edits. Rewrote three whys that were generic or misgendered so the row and its reason match: level 1 range gap, level 2 grounding on Shunpo, level 6 stun-cancels-channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction — Death Lotus is a channel, so Petrifying Gaze cancels it — appeared only in the TL;DR and was missing from the fields that tell you when to press R. Voracity's cooldown refund was never named. The Grievous Wounds on Death Lotus (missingInteractions) appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Death Lotus carries the channel flag and matches Riot's text ('while she channels'), and it also applies healing reduction — which is aimed straight at Twin Fang's heal, the engine of Cassiopeia's drain fight.
audit.corrected: Put the channel-cancel into dosFull[1].d and phases[4].why, the Grievous Wounds into breakdown.carry, and Voracity's reset-refund into dontsFull[2].d and enemyWin. Did not write a magnitude for the healing cut — the kit gives no number.

audit.why: It is the field that carries the numbers.
audit.corrected: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8, Bouncing Blade 11/10/9/8/7, Death Lotus 75/60/45 against your 120/100/80 R, plus the Voracity caveat that any nearby death refunds all of it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, dontsFull[0].d was a name-swap template (lint).
audit.why: Titles promised Death Lotus, chasing, and Miasma discipline; bodies discussed none of them.
audit.corrected: All three grounded in Katarina's actual kit.

edits.before: Q poke on his last-hits — the poison-into-E pattern starts at level 1 and your DPS already out-trades most mids.
edits.after: Katarina has no ranged answer at level 1 — Q from 850 and Twin Fang punish every step she takes toward the wave.

edits.before: W changes the geometry: miasma GROUNDS dashes. Drop it on his engage path and the lane's mobility advantage evaporates.
edits.after: W changes the geometry: Miasma GROUNDS Shunpo. Drop it on the dagger she wants and the blink simply does not fire.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze online — the all-in answer. Face-stun his engage or slow his retreat; either way the fangs finish it.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze online — Death Lotus is a channel, so the stun cancels it outright and the fangs finish her off.

edits.before: Katarina wins by landing Shunpo, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Katarina wins by turning one kill into Voracity refunds and chaining daggers through a lane you stopped grounding.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Check it before every step-up. - R Petrifying Gaze is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5: step up inside that gap, but Voracity refunds it on any nearby death. - Bouncing Blade is 11s early and the dagger on the ground is your tell. - Death Lotus is 75/60/45; your 120/100/80 R cancels the channel.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by DPS — Death Lotus cuts the Twin Fang healing you drain on, so stun the channel early and the extended fight is yours.

edits.before: Best wave: a fast Q-E shove that crashes and funds Tear stacks — your DPS clears faster than most control mages from level 5 on. Worst wave: a frozen wave at his tower while an assassin roams — you have no boots (passive) but no dash either; warded rivers or no shoves. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Katarina is executable.
edits.after: Death Lotus is a channel — Petrifying Gaze cancels it mid-cast, so hold the stun for the moment she commits, not for the walk-up.

edits.before: That’s Katarina’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Every dagger she drops is a Shunpo waiting to happen — put Miasma on it, not on the wave.

edits.before: Turn your back during his commit
edits.after: Turn your back during her commit

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Voracity refunds her cooldowns on any nearby death, so chasing off your poison hands her a fresh Shunpo you cannot follow.

edits.before: Commit on Shunpo’s cooldown, on your Seraph's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Shunpo’s cooldown, on your Seraph's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Waste miasma on wave or spacing. Turn your back during his commit. Chase resets past your own miasma. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.
edits.after: Waste miasma on wave or spacing. Turn your back during her commit. Chase resets past your own miasma. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.

edits.before: Her R deals big AoE burst but roots her in place; if she ults into your Miasma/Q poison she takes huge damage while animation-locked.
edits.after: Death Lotus is a channel your R cancels outright, and it applies Grievous Wounds — so stun it before it starts or your Twin Fang healing is cut.

notes: Level chart already agreed across both layers and with the packet on all seven rows, so no chart edits. Katarina's Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' derived flag in the kit file, which contradicts Riot's description ('throws a Dagger that bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground') — the parser almost certainly caught the word 'ground'. I did not write any grounding claim for her Q; recorded in unverified. The missingInteractions headline says Death Lotus 'halves' your sustain; the kit gives no number, so I wrote 'cuts' rather than a magnitude.
